claire (AE): Zenexa posted an RFI asking for POC acceptance criteria, reserved pricing bands, overage rates, KMS compat, and a concise capability matrix. Need quick sync.
sam (SE): I'll own POC runbook. They asked 210 qps gen + 900 rpm embed. Recommend 14-day pilot: gen p95 < 700ms, embed p95 < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%.
noah (Solutions Eng): For sustained 210 qps suggest Dedicated with 2x A100 equiv. Ballpark reserved: $20k-$32k/mo depending on region/term. Pilot discount 20% off low-end. Overage: $0.13/gen-token-eq, $0.0012/embed.
claire (AE): They also asked if we can limit pilot to EU region and provide audit exports.
isabel (Security Eng): Yes. Copy-friendly lines: "Region-restricted hosted pilots (EU) supported; Private/on-prem for strict locality. BYOK via KMIP HSM or Cloud KMS; hosted BYOK via envelope encryption. Audit logs (admin actions, model deploys, key usage) available for S3 export or API pull. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reports available under NDA; annual third-party penetration tests."
noah (Solutions Eng): Add rollback behavior: auto-failover to compatible hosted model in nearest region, or synchronous fallback to smaller model. Note potential latency increase.
sam (SE): Preflight checklist for their infra:
```
- Allow outbound 443 to eu.api.redwood.ai and dedicated-region endpoints
- Optional: whitelist our egress IPs
- Healthcheck: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- TLS verify: openssl s_client -connect eu.api.redwood.ai:443 -brief
```
claire (AE): Contracts ask about refundable trial deposit and milestone extension.
noah (Solutions Eng): Standard: one-month reserved fee held as deposit, refundable if pilot acceptance met. Milestone: 50% sustained usage for 7 days -> apply committed discount.
isabel (Security Eng): Also add ephemeral data handling: KV cache TTL default=0, caches scrubbed on termination; data-in-transit TLS; at-rest encrypted via customer KMS when requested.
claire (AE): Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/zenexa-rfi/ (capmatrix + DPA + SOW). Action items: sam=runbook+preflight; noah=pricing+capmatrix edits; isabel=security copy+DPA note. I'll assemble and ping legal. rfi-bot: RFI logged and assigned to claire (AE) due 2026-04-12.
claire (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: Will post compiled packet here when ready.
